Previously he had raced but once this winter, yet the form shown over the first 8 miles was so good that it is questionable whether he walked better or faster during the years 1923, 1924, 1927 and 1928, when he was rarely beaten at 7—10 miles on the road. J.
Tommy Green went off the course when holding a good lead and eventually finished 11th. Other Bels. were Rathbone, 4th; Rickards, 12th and Bidgood, 13th, for the Police, and J.
King 30th, Rickards 31st, Khlopin 38th (the position in which he eventually finished), Field 39th, McMullen 41st and J.
A party of 17, some being members of other Clubs, collected outside the "Swan and Sugar Loaf," Croydon, and started off at 9-45 p.m., a slight delay being made for J.
The performances of Clemens (Long Jump) and Fletcher (Seven Miles Walk—54min. 15sec.) are mentioned elsewhere. J.

Two teams had been entered in the National 20 Miles Championship to be held at Fort Dunlop, Birmingham, on May 7th, and we went to the Midlands feeling confident that our walkers would make a good show, even though we were handicapped by the absence of several of our stalwarts. J.
We have in our ranks at the moment three County champions at Two Miles. They are J.
Rickards eager to improve upon even last years' very fine performances, and strong backing will be forthcoming from J.
Our second man was Len Fletcher, walking in something like his old form; and third for us came Don Brown—an excellent performance. J.
Expense and the difficulties of the long journey may limit our numbers, but we need have no fear that we shall not be represented by a first-class team of eight. Green, Rickards, Bentley, J.

With the New Year, we shall see them back in harness again, preparing for the 20 miles Championship, which has eluded us in recent years, despite some really fine walking on the part of our men. Bentley, Rickards, Bidgood, Martin, J.

Twenty-seven of our own walkers entered—quite good representation—but several of our men who have given such excellent service in past races were still resting; and circumstances precluded the entry of several others who have added lustre to our teams in the past, and will do so again in the future…
